up: Retrieve IC50 activity data against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor). Output columns must be exactly: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Apply filters: target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return DISTINCT rows based on the specified output columns. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.description AS assay_description, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.activity_comment, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
